info.title: Ninja PNS — Solutioning
info.description: Solutioning and pricing workflow for Ninja Xpress Indonesia. Routes each new shipper requirement to Commercial or the PNS team by account type, service and potential revenue, then tracks it from intake through pricing, review and approval to a signed contract. Identity comes from the platform's auth proxy (x-forwarded-email); authorisation is enforced per route, and margin/cost fields are omitted from responses for roles without the seeMargin permission.

get.summary: Readiness probe used by the platform
Who the caller is and which actions they are permitted to take

200.description: Signed-in user with a resolved permission map

get.summary: List solutioning tickets, filtered and scoped to the caller's role
get.description: Legal sees only accepted deals; every other group reads the whole pipeline. PSP is unscoped deliberately — judging a rate needs the surrounding context, and PSP gets pulled into discussion after approving. With awaiting=true the list is the pricing queue, scoped to whichever side owes the price. The margin field is present only for callers with the seeMargin permission.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Matches shipper name or ticket ref

parameters.name: psp_reviewed
parameters.description: Restrict to tickets PSP has decided on at least once, regardless of current status — feeds the PSP Finished queue

post.summary: Raise a new solutioning ticket and route it automatically
post.description: Creates the shipper if the name is new. The routing engine decides from account type, service and revenue whether Sales or PNS owes the price, and whether PNS must review afterwards. Requires the createTicket permission (Commercial or Admin).

201.description: Created, with the assigned ref and opening status

post.summary: Attach a price and advance the ticket to its next stage
post.description: Only the side that owes the price may call this. Routing checks, in order: (1) the 5A ceiling for the ticket's service/account/revenue band (PRICING_GUARD via guard_for) — a manual-review band (managed account, either FTL line ≥30 Mio) or a breached discount tier goes straight to Pending PSP Approval, PSP's by rule; (2) a breached margin tier, or the manual below_bottom flag (LTL/B2BR only, 400 otherwise), goes to Pending Head Review for the Sales Head to acknowledge; (3) otherwise PNS review if Sales priced a deal ≥30 Mio; (4) otherwise Proposal Submitted, or Pending Exec Sign-off for a managed account. Escalating to PSP outside these rules is not part of this endpoint — see POST .../status.

post.summary: Move a ticket to another status, accept it, or close it as lost
post.description: Accepting or marking lost requires the acceptProposal permission (Commercial owns the shipper outcome). status="Pending PSP Approval" is a forward for a margin check, not a send-back: it requires sendToPsp, no reason, and does not notify anyone as "sent back to you" — PSP as a group is notified instead. It is also the only discretionary path to PSP (used by both the Escalate-to-PSP and Send-to-PSP buttons), so it additionally requires the ticket to pass may_go_to_psp — a managed account (Strategic/Hypercare) or one the PNS Head has opened on an exception — refused with 400 otherwise. Every other status requires sendBackProposal and a reason, and reassigns who owes the re-quote.

patch.summary: Correct a ticket's intake after submission
patch.description: Requires editInput (Commercial or Admin). Changing account type or potential revenue additionally requires editAcctOrRev (Commercial Head), because both feed the routing rule. The rule is re-run on the corrected facts and resp/needs_review updated, but the status is left alone so a correction does not pull the ticket out of the queue it is sitting in. Every edit is written to the ticket history and the audit log; status_since is not touched, so the SLA clock keeps running.

200.description: Updated, or unchanged if nothing differed

post.summary: Hand the ticket to a different salesperson
post.description: Commercial Head only (setSales). Looks the new PIC's email up from the users table and notifies them.

post.summary: Put a lost or cancelled deal back into the pipeline
post.description: Commercial Head only (reopen). Refuses unless the ticket is currently Lost or Cancel. Clears the outcome and loss reason, and sets resp from the status it reopens into.

post.summary: Set or clear who in PSP is handling this ticket
post.description: Requires pspAssign (any PSP member, or Admin). Flat by design — there is no PSP head/staff distinction, so any PSP member may assign a ticket to themselves or a teammate, on any ticket regardless of who else is assigned. Passing an empty or omitted assignee clears it. Notifies the new assignee unless they assigned it to themselves.

post.summary: Final submit after PSP clears a margin that needed no PNS review
post.description: Requires the same ownership as attaching a price (whichever side owes it). Only valid when psp_ready is true on the ticket — otherwise 400. Does not re-enter the price; that already happened in POST .../price. Clears psp_ready and advances to Proposal Submitted.

delete.summary: Erase a ticket from the recycle bin permanently
delete.description: Admin only (purgeTicket), and only for a ticket already in the bin — there is no one-step hard delete of a live ticket. The intake, pricing, history and approvals cascade away with it. Not reversible.

get.summary: List the photos and documents attached to a ticket
get.description: Metadata only — bytes come from /api/files/{fid}, so listing a ticket never drags blobs across. Ordered by kind then upload time.

post.summary: Attach a photo of the goods or a supporting document
post.description: multipart/form-data. Open to every group: Commercial supplies the cargo photos with the intake, PNS attaches solution diagrams, Legal attaches contract drafts. Hard limits: 5 MB per file (the bytes travel to OceanBase in one packet) and an allowlist of image, PDF, Word, Excel, CSV and plain-text types. SVG is refused because it can carry script. The browser downscales images before sending. Notifies the PNS owner and sales PIC.

415.description: File type not on the allowlist

get.summary: Download or display one attachment
get.description: Returns the raw bytes with the stored content type. Images on the inline allowlist (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF) are served inline so they render in an img tag; everything else is forced to download via Content-Disposition. X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff is always set so the browser cannot reinterpret the declared type.

delete.description: The person who uploaded it, or an Admin. A real delete — the row and its bytes go.

get.summary: Read the question and discussion thread on a ticket
get.description: Oldest first. Readable by any signed-in user regardless of group — the thread exists so Commercial, PNS, PSP, Legal and CSO can resolve ambiguity in one place. open_questions counts entries flagged as questions that nobody has closed.

post.summary: Post a question or reply, tagging people by email
post.description: Open to every group. Mentions come from the mentions array and from any @someone@domain written in the body; only active registered accounts resolve, and the response's status field reports who was actually tagged plus any address that matched nobody. The ticket's PNS owner and sales PIC are notified on every post in addition to those tagged, minus the author. Body is capped at 4000 characters.

201.description: Posted; status names who was tagged

post.summary: Mark a question as answered
post.description: Only entries flagged as questions can be closed. Permitted to the person who asked, or to a PNS/Commercial Head or Admin for questions that have gone stale. Idempotent — closing an already-closed question succeeds without changing it.

get.summary: List everyone who can be tagged in a discussion
get.description: Active users with name, email and group label only — no role level. Readable by any signed-in user because tagging by email is the point; it deliberately does not require manageUsers the way /api/users does.

get.summary: Suggested values for the intake form's free-text fields
get.description: The intake deliberately does not constrain commodity, product, vehicle body, palletisation, destination type or frequency — a shipper turned up with medicine, which no fixed list predicted. This returns a seed list plus every distinct value anyone has typed on a past ticket, so one-off answers become suggestions for the next person. Also returns the salesperson and shipper lists and the enum values the UI needs.

post.summary: Set the PNS owner and/or the price reviewer
post.description: PNS Head or Admin. Owner assignment is no longer limited to PNS-priced tickets — Sales-priced work still lands on PNS for review, so it needs an owner too. Each slot notifies the person named; an empty string clears it. Recorded in history without restarting the SLA clock.

post.summary: Acknowledge a price flagged below the bottom rate
post.description: Only the head of the team that priced it may acknowledge — Commercial Head for Sales-priced tickets, PNS Head for PNS-priced ones. This is visibility, not the margin sign-off: it always advances to Pending PSP Approval, which is now mandatory for every below-bottom price. Records an approval.

post.summary: Approve or reject a margin as the pricing desk
post.description: PSP (or Admin) only — any PSP member, no head/staff distinction. If PSP cannot decide, the PNS Head may approve or reject on their behalf via pspOverride; a note is required and the decision is recorded as an override. price_file/price_url/margin_pct/discount_pct let PSP enter or correct the pricing figure in the same call, which matters because a ticket often reaches PSP precisely because nobody else could price it (a managed account with no rate card) — leave them blank to decide on whatever is already attached. A ticket can arrive here three ways: mandatory after a below-bottom head acknowledgement on a ticket carrying a PSP exception, or a manual-review 5A band (Strategic/Hypercare, either FTL line ≥30 Mio, Sameday discount >20%), or a discretionary Escalate/Send-to-PSP via POST .../status. On approve: if the ticket was already Pending PNS Review, it goes straight to Proposal Submitted (that review is done); if it still needs PNS review, it goes to Pending PNS Review rather than skip that; otherwise it goes back to Pending PNS or Pending Sales (whoever priced it) with psp_ready set, for an explicit final submit via /submit-proposal — approval is not the same as the proposal being ready. Rejecting requires a note and returns the ticket to whichever side owes the price, to re-quote.

post.summary: Accept the price Sales built, as an ordinary PNS reviewer
post.description: Any PNS member (markReviewed). The gate a Standard deal reaches when Sales priced it at or above Rp 30 Mio: PNS reads the number before it goes to the shipper. Refuses with 409 unless the ticket is in 'Pending Review - PNS'. This endpoint is only the yes — disagreeing is POST .../status back to Pending Sales with a reason, and 'there is no rate to price against' is POST .../status to Pending Review - PSP, still gated on may_go_to_psp. Distinct from /pns-final, which is the Head finalising a whole watched solution; the two are different acts by different people and deliberately do not share an endpoint.

200.description: Review recorded; the ticket moves to the next gate, normally Proposal Submitted

post.summary: Finalise a watched solution and its pricing, as the Head of PNS
post.description: Head of PNS (markReviewed). The FIRST gate on a Hypercare, Strategic or Must Win deal, whoever priced it: the solution is finished here before PSP or C-level are asked to sign anything. Refuses with 409 unless the ticket is in 'Pending Review - Head PNS'. The next status is decided by the approval chain recorded when the price was attached, not named by the caller, so the call cannot skip a later gate.

200.description: Finalised; the ticket moves to the next gate in its chain

get.summary: List dropped requests with the date, the person and the reason
get.description: Readable by anyone signed in. Tickets currently at status 'Cancel' and not deleted, newest first. Cancelling requires a reason, so the reason field is populated for anything cancelled after 2026-08-18; older rows may read 'not recorded' for the person because who and when are read out of ticket_history rather than from columns on the ticket — log_status() has always written the actor and timestamp there, so no migration was needed to answer this. Where a ticket was cancelled, reopened and cancelled again, the LAST cancellation is reported, because that is the state the ticket is actually in.

get.summary: List the recycle bin — tickets that were soft-deleted
get.description: PNS Admin only (restoreTicket permission). Ordered by deletion time, newest first. Deleted tickets keep their history so a restore puts everything back.

get.summary: Read one ticket with its intake, pricing and status history
get.description: Feeds the ticket detail screen. cost, margin and bottom_margin are present only for callers with the seeMargin permission (PNS, PSP, CSO, Admin) — they are never sent otherwise.

200.description: The ticket, scoped to what the caller may see

delete.summary: Move a ticket to the recycle bin
delete.description: Soft delete — the ticket leaves every list but keeps its history and can be restored. PNS Admin only.

post.summary: Restore a ticket from the recycle bin
post.description: PNS Admin only. The ticket returns with its original status, and PNS and Commercial are notified that it reappeared.

get.summary: Pipeline counts and win rate for the dashboard tiles
get.description: Win rate is won divided by decided deals, excluding cancelled tickets. Returns null when nothing has been decided yet.

get.summary: List CAPA tickets, optionally filtered by status

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Pending PNS, Submitted or CAPA Closed

post.summary: Raise a corrective action against an existing shipper
post.description: Commercial (or Admin) only. CAPA is deliberately separate from solutioning — no pricing, routing or revenue. At least one service type is required.

get.summary: List evidence and documents attached to a CAPA

post.summary: Attach evidence to a CAPA
post.description: multipart/form-data. Same 5 MB cap and type allowlist as ticket attachments, and open to every group. kind is evidence or document. Notifies the assignee and the person who raised it.

415.description: File type not on the allowlist

get.summary: Download or display one CAPA attachment
get.description: Same rules as ticket attachments: allowlisted images render inline, everything else is forced to download, nosniff always set.

delete.description: The person who uploaded it, or an Admin.

post.summary: Submit the PNS proposal for a CAPA and assign an owner
post.description: PNS (or Admin) only. Moves the CAPA to Submitted and notifies Commercial to verify it.

post.summary: Close a CAPA once the corrective action is verified
post.description: Commercial (or Admin) only. Records who closed it and when.

get.summary: List everyone registered in the app, with the valid role values
get.description: Feeds the Administration screen. Requires the manageUsers permission (PNS Admin or PNS Head). Ordered active first, then by group, heads before staff. Also returns the allowed groups, levels and teams so the UI never invents a value the API would reject.

200.description: Registered users plus the allowed role values

post.summary: Register a person so SSO will let them into the app
post.description: Google authenticates; this row authorises. Requires manageUsers. Granting the Admin group additionally requires grantAdmin, so a PNS Head cannot mint administrators. Commercial users must carry a team. Returns 409 if the email is already registered.

201.description: Registered; ref is the normalised email

get.summary: Names that can own a ticket or CAPA
get.description: Active users in the PNS or Admin groups, heads first. Readable by any signed-in user because the assignee dropdowns need it.

patch.summary: Change a person's role, team, name or access
patch.description: Requires manageUsers. Moving anyone into or out of the Admin group requires grantAdmin. Refuses to change your own group or level, to deactivate your own account, or to remove the last active Admin — any of those could lock everyone out.

delete.summary: Revoke a person's access to the app
delete.description: Sets active=0 rather than deleting the row, because ticket and CAPA history records people by name. Requires manageUsers; revoking an Admin also requires grantAdmin. Refuses on your own account and on the last active Admin.

get.summary: The caller's notification feed with unread count
get.description: Each event carries an audience; a caller sees it when their group, exact role label or name matches. Admin sees everything. Read state is per user.

get.summary: Read the caller's notification preferences
get.description: Also reports whether the deployment has SMTP configured at all, so the UI can hide the email toggle when there is nothing to toggle.

post.summary: Turn the caller's personal email notifications on or off
post.description: Opt-out is per person and applies only to email; in-app notifications are unaffected.

post.summary: Check whether the backend can reach the SMTP relay
post.description: Admin or PNS Head (manageUsers). Opens a real connection from the pod, negotiates STARTTLS and authenticates if credentials are set, then reports what happened. Never raises — a failure comes back as reachable:false with the exception text, because the whole point is to diagnose. With send=true it also delivers one test message to the caller's own address.

parameters.name: send
parameters.description: Also send a test message to the caller

post.summary: Mark all of the caller's notifications as read

get.summary: List tickets whose status this build does not recognise
get.description: Admin or PNS Head (manageUsers). Written after a deploy collision left a ticket under a status string ('Pending Review - PSP') this build had never used, invisible to any queue that filters by status. V20 corrected the one confirmed case; this finds anything similar without guessing what an unfamiliar value ought to be renamed to, by comparing against the same status list the frontend uses.

200.description: Tickets with an unrecognised status, empty if none

UserEmail.name: email
UserEmail.description: The person's Google account address; matched case-insensitively

NoRole.description: Authenticated but no role has been assigned yet

Forbidden.description: The caller's role may not take this action

permissions.description: Action name to boolean, resolved for this caller

build.description: Backend build marker, bumped on each deploy so a redeploy can be verified from outside

sso.description: True when the platform auth proxy identified this request

dev_fallback.description: True when SSO did not identify the request and DEV_USER_EMAIL was used instead — an unsafe configuration the UI warns about

name.description: Display name; this is what ticket and CAPA history records

active.description: False means access is revoked; the row is kept for history

is_self.description: True on the caller's own row, which they may not re-role or revoke

email_optout.description: True when this person has turned personal emails off

email_configured.description: False when the deployment has no SMTP settings, in which case no mail is sent to anyone

email_from.description: The address mail is sent as

configured.description: SMTP_HOST and SMTP_FROM are both set

reachable.description: A connection was opened successfully from the pod

detail.description: What happened, including the exception type and message on failure

sent_to.description: Set when send=true and a test message went out

status.description: The raw, unrecognised value stored on the ticket

size_bytes.description: Size after the browser's downscale, not the original

is_image.description: True when it is safe to render inline

url.description: Relative path to the bytes, usable directly as an img src or href

group.description: Author's role group, shown as a pill

mentions.description: Emails that resolved to a real account and were notified

is_mine.description: True on the caller's own posts

body.description: Up to 4000 characters. @someone@domain here is picked up as a mention too.

mentions.description: Emails to notify; unknown addresses are reported back, not silently dropped

UserPatch.description: Every field is optional; omitted fields are left as they are.

active.description: False revokes access, true restores it

needs_review.description: True only when Sales priced it and PNS must review

margin.description: Percent. Omitted entirely for callers without the seeMargin permission.

price_file.description: Human label for the attached price

price_url.description: http(s) link to the pricing spreadsheet; access is governed by the sheet itself, not by this app

open_questions.description: Unanswered questions on this ticket's discussion thread

psp_assignee.description: Which PSP member is handling this. Flat — any PSP member may set this on any ticket, there is no head/staff distinction.

psp_ready.description: PSP approved a margin that did not also need PNS review, so it is back with whoever priced it for an explicit final submit rather than a re-price.

psp_decision.description: PSP's most recent decision on this ticket, if any — independent of psp_ready and of the ticket's current status

revenue.description: Potential revenue in IDR, as it stood when the ticket was dropped

owner.description: PNS PIC at the time, if one had been assigned

at.description: When it was cancelled, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM. An em dash where no history row records it.

by.description: Who cancelled it, or 'not recorded' for a ticket cancelled before the history carried it

reason.description: Mandatory at the time of cancelling; the only record of why the deal stopped

actor.description: Display name of whoever moved it

at.description: Timestamp, newest first in the list

input.description: The raw intake payload as submitted by Commercial

input_cleared.description: True once PNS has cleared the intake, which is what unlocks the Project Charter

price_url.description: Link to the pricing spreadsheet, if one was attached

cost.description: Restricted — omitted for callers without seeMargin

margin.description: Percent. Restricted — omitted for callers without seeMargin

bottom_margin.description: Product bottom margin for this service; null where none is published (Sameday). Restricted.

rate_card.description: Name of the published rate card the price must be built from

rate_card_url.description: Link to the pricing tool for this service, where one exists (currently LTL and B2BR)

win_rate.description: Percent of decided deals; null when none decided

brief.description: Brief summary; carries onto the Project Charter

payload.description: The rest of the intake form

price_file.description: Human label shown next to the link, e.g. "Rate card v2". Required; the UI substitutes "Pricing spreadsheet" when only a link is given.

price_url.description: Link to the pricing spreadsheet. Must be http(s) — any other scheme is refused with 400, because the value is rendered as an anchor other users click. Max 1000 characters.

margin_pct.description: Percent. Checked against the 5A ceiling for the ticket's service and revenue band (PRICING_GUARD); a margin below the band's floor routes to the Sales Head, or to PSP where the band itself is manual-review.

discount_pct.description: Percent. The lever Sameday is capped on (20%) instead of margin; also used where a service's tier is "standard" (any discount at all is a breach).

below_bottom.description: Manual flag, in addition to the computed 5A check. Only accepted when the ticket's service has a published bottom margin (LTL, B2BR) — 400 otherwise. Routes to the Sales Head for acknowledgement; PSP sign-off follows only if the ticket also carries a PSP exception (see may_go_to_psp), otherwise the Sales Head's acknowledgement is the final sign-off.

reason.description: Required when sending back to a pending status

AssignIn.description: Pass owner, reviewer, or both. An empty string clears that slot; an omitted field leaves it unchanged. At least one must be present.

owner.description: PNS member who works the ticket

reviewer.description: PNS member who checks a Sales-built price

InputPatch.description: Every field optional. payload is merged key-by-key into the stored intake, not replaced wholesale.

revenue.description: Potential revenue in IDR; needs editAcctOrRev

acct_type.description: Stored on the shipper; needs editAcctOrRev

name.description: Display name of an active user

remembered.description: Field name to suggested values, seeded with common answers and extended with everything typed on past tickets

assignee.description: Display name of a PSP member; empty or omitted clears the assignment

note.description: Required when rejecting, or when a PNS Head is deciding on PSP's behalf (pspOverride)

price_file.description: Human label for PSP's own pricing figure. Only written if price_file or price_url is given; leave both blank to decide on whatever is already attached.

price_url.description: Link to PSP's own pricing spreadsheet. Must be http(s); same validation as POST .../price.

margin_pct.description: Percent. Overwrites the ticket's margin if given; does not affect routing here, PSP's decision is already the manual-review outcome.

discount_pct.description: Percent. Overwrites the ticket's discount if given.

link_url.description: http(s) reference link, e.g. a tracking page or complaint thread

file_count.description: Number of attachments on this CAPA

link_url.description: Optional http(s) link added with the proposal
